rules: The brain never emits raw world coordinates.
The brain never selects low-level animation assets directly.
All motion resolves through named office behaviors and anchors.
Movement is optional; Isabel should remain conversational unless physical movement improves the explanation.
Pointing is allowed only after the character is physically stable.
Speech content and physical behavior are planned together but executed by separate runtime coordinators.

examples.speech: There is a schedule issue I want to show you.
